{{Quote|There's six or eight of them, I think -- local moisture farmers led by a big thug named Sont Toipo. If you stop Toipo, the rest will probably run off.|[[Kitster Chanchani Banai|Kitster Banai]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:KB" />}}
'''Sont Toipo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] vigilante leader who worked on [[Drik Bandrik]]'s payroll on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I don't care whether Kitster's guilty. Drik says he's a troublemaker, and Drik knows best.|Sont Toipo, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:KB" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Drik Bandrik, a slaver who became upset at [[Kitster Chanchani Banai|Kitster Banai]] for his persistent attempts to improve the lives of slaves, framed him in the murder of a [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] named [[Krin Vel]]. Sont Toipo was then tasked with organizing an angry mob of farmers to find and kill Kitster. Fortunately for Kitster, a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] traveling through [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] agreed to help him, and hunt down Sont Toipo. Kitster surmised that the mob would consist of six or eight local moisture farmers, but he pleaded with the spacer to only kill Sont Toipo. Kitster hoped that the rest of the mob would run off after he was killed.<ref name="SWG:KB" />

The traveler agreed, and set out to successfully kill Toipo, while making an effort to spare the lives of the farmers. It later turned out that Krin Vel was not murdered at all, but was rather paid by Drik Bandrik to leave Mos Espa long enough for a lynch mob to be formed.<ref name="SWG:KB" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateThugAqualishMale.png|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Sont Toipo]]
Sont Toipo was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG:KB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Players who performed a series of quests for Kitster in Mos Espa had to hunt down and kill Sont Toipo outside the [[City/Legends|city]].<ref name="SWG:KB" />
